observations: Durable ownership remains generation 1 predecessor; no transfer evidence exists yet.
Existing shadow READY evidence is sufficient for owner-mediated transfer when predecessor is alive and fresh-reads it.

execution.json generation=9 conflicts numerically with ownership.json generation=1, but execution generation is execution-spec revision while ownership generation alone owns invocation authority; these counters must not be conflated.
The planned successor_scheduled_for timestamp cannot establish wake correctness; actual observed wake evidence must be used.

Current protocol can deadlock if predecessor owner has already terminated before observing READY, because SHADOW is forbidden to self-promote. This is a recovery-domain hypothesis, not permission to bypass ownership now.

diagnostic_hypothesis.claim: Controlled overlap needs an explicit owner-loss recovery/lease-expiry path in addition to normal owner-mediated CAS transfer, otherwise an early-dead predecessor can strand a READY successor.
diagnostic_hypothesis.discriminator: First determine whether predecessor is still capable of owner-mediated transfer. If not, classify sample as ownership-transfer failure and source/test a fenced takeover mechanism separately rather than silently self-promoting.
